announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: Interim Results are released following the Share Premium Cancellation effective in October. Shareholders should monitor for financial performance updates.

announcements.headline: Share Premium Cancellation effective
announcements.insight: Following the August proposal and September AGM approval, the share premium cancellation is now effective. This administrative capital action finalizes the earlier governance steps.

announcements.insight: Board Appointment follows the AGM notice. Shareholders should watch for details on the new director's role and influence on governance.

announcements.headline: Final Results for the year ended 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: Software Circle has released its final results for the year ended 31 March 2026. This scheduled filing provides the first recorded update on the company's performance.
